How can I fund this proposal?

Any existing contributor can be a NSP and sponsor his treasury proposal. 
Then this is the procedure to push the proposal to the referendum stage with simpleMajority bias: [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/2423-how-to-execute-a-simplemajority-proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/2423-how-to-execute-a-simplemajority-proposal)

Edgeware already have 2 explorers.
Polkascan and subscan. What's the problem here why we need another explorer

Yes, we have 4 explorer options for Edgeware network.

[Subscan](https://edgeware.subscan.io/)
[Edgscan](https://beresheet.edgscan.com/)
[Polkadot.js - explorer](https://polkadot.js.org/apps/#/explorer)

And one more small explorer made by us
[Expedition](https://beresheet.vercel.app)

But the problem is EVM version not working properly and other 2 are hosted under other platforms.

We are going to develop Hybrid Explorer that's different from all other projects. Both edgeware WASM and edgeware EVM network data available in one explorer. 
For example, if you check your transaction hash on our explorer, it gives edgeware EVM and edgeware WASM data in a single page. At the same time our Hybrid API service is useful for developers
